column1: #  - a definition counts at the top level of the file or directly in a namespace eval body (nested namespaces included); a proc inside another proc's body or inside an if is created only when that code runs and is not held;
#  - proc is a function, named as written (::shapes::qualified keeps its qualification);
#  - namespace eval NAME is a package, named as written (::absolute::path);
#  - variable NAME and set NAME VALUE at those places are variables; a set that only reads (set count) is not;

#  - oo::class create NAME is a class; in its body method, class method, constructor and destructor are methods and the names of `variable a b` are fields; a method inside oo::define CLASS {..} or oo::objdefine OBJ {..} is a method;
#  - calls, package, namespace export, unexport, superclass, and a method whose name is a braced list are not definitions.
